name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken Over Roasted Spaghetti Squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of each squash; halve lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of each squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add flour to a plate. Dredge the chicken cutlets in flour, shake off excess, and add to the pot. Working in batches if necessary. pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, slice the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the pot (with leftover oil from cooking) to medium heat. Add mushrooms, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add flour to the pot and stir to coat mushrooms. Pour in broth, milk, and Dijon. Return chicken to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp all-purpose flour
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove pot from the heat. Juice lemons into the pot and add half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish); stir to combine.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between bowls. Top with chicken and mushroom sauce. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!
